pages.title: About
pages.body:
Everybody has a shift.

Early starts. Night shifts. Twelve hours on your feet. Forty at a desk, counting down to Friday. However yours goes, you put in the hours.

The good part is what happens after.

A line in the water. The back nine on a Tuesday. Cornhole boards in the driveway. The cottage, finally.

OFF SHFT makes the hat you wear when you get there.

Days off don’t always fall on a weekend. Plenty of people get a Tuesday and a Wednesday. These hats don’t mind which.

The logo is an O with clock hands at 5:00. Quitting time.

We keep the designs small and quiet, with plenty of empty fabric. Every hat is made to order and shipped to you.

You put in the hours. This time is yours.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.body:
How do the hats fit?

It depends on the style.

  • Dad hat: soft and unstructured, with a curved brim.
  • Structured snapback: a firm front that holds its shape, with a snap at the back.
  • Trucker: mesh at the back.

[CONFIRM: the profile (low, mid or high) and brim of each style we sell, from the partner’s spec sheet; list only the styles on sale, and add the golf cap if it launches] The Size & fit page has the numbers.

What size do I need?

[CONFIRM: every style we sell is one size with an adjustable back] Measure around your head where a hat sits, then check the range on the Size & fit page.

What are the hats made of?

The designs are embroidered, not printed. The hats themselves: [CONFIRM: material of each style, from the partner’s spec sheet].

How do I clean my hat?

Follow the care label inside it. [CONFIRM: each style has a care label inside; care instructions for each style, from the partner’s spec sheet]

Are the hats made to order?

Yes. There’s no warehouse full of OFF SHFT hats waiting around. Yours is made after you order it, then shipped straight to you. Making it usually takes 2–5 business days. [CONFIRM: Printful’s time; Printify’s is 2–7]

How long does shipping take?

Once your hat is made, delivery usually takes:

  • Canada: 3–4 business days [CONFIRM: true if Printful makes your hats in Ontario; see store/pages/shipping-returns.md]
  • US: 3–4 business days [CONFIRM: Printful’s time; at Printify it depends on the shop]

All in, that’s about 1 to 2 weeks. Shipping costs [CONFIRM: shipping rates, or the free-shipping threshold]. You’ll see the exact cost at checkout before you pay. The Shipping & returns page has the details.

Will I get a tracking number?

Yes. When your hat ships, you’ll get an email with the tracking link. [CONFIRM: every shipping method you offer has tracking]

Do you ship outside Canada and the US?

Not right now. [CONFIRM: shipping zones are Canada and the US only] Prices are in Canadian dollars. [CONFIRM: whether US shoppers see US dollars at checkout]

Will I pay duties or import fees?

  • Canada: [CONFIRM: the Canada duties line from store/pages/shipping-returns.md, once you know where Printful makes your hats]
  • US: no. Orders to the US ship from inside the US. [CONFIRM: each of your hats is made at Printful’s US shops, and a US order can’t be sent from Canada when they’re out of it. Printful sends each order to the closest shop that has the item]

Can I return or exchange a hat?

Each hat is made for your order, so we can’t take returns or exchanges if you change your mind or it doesn’t fit. Not sure about fit? Check Size & fit or email us before you order. [CONFIRM: the owner approves the draft policy in store/pages/shipping-returns.md]

What if it arrives damaged or wrong, or doesn’t arrive?

If your hat arrives stitched wrong, damaged or not what you ordered, email us within [CONFIRM: number of days, under 30] days of delivery. Send your order number and a photo. We’ll send a new one or refund you, at no cost to you. You don’t need to send it back.

If it hasn’t arrived [CONFIRM: number] business days after it shipped, email us your order number. If it’s lost, we’ll send a new one or refund you.

Can I send a hat as a gift?

Yes. At checkout, put their name and address in as the shipping address. [CONFIRM: whether the packing slip shows prices] [CONFIRM: whether gift cards are offered]

How do I reach you?

Email [CONFIRM: support email] or use the form on the Contact page. If it’s about an order, include your order number. We reply within [CONFIRM: a reply time you can keep].

Every hat is made to order, then shipped to you. Here’s how long that takes and what we do if something goes wrong.

Made to order

Your hat is made after you order it. That usually takes 2–5 business days. [CONFIRM: Printful’s time; Printify’s is 2–7]

Shipping

We ship to Canada and the US. [CONFIRM: the store’s shipping zones are Canada and the US only]

All in, that’s about 1 to 2 weeks.

Changes and cancellations

Need to fix your address or cancel? Email us within [CONFIRM: a time limit that ends before production starts; see “Order timing” below] of ordering. After that your hat may already be in production, and we can’t change or cancel it.

Returns

If something’s wrong

If your hat arrives stitched wrong, damaged or not what you ordered, email us within [CONFIRM: number of days, under 30] days of delivery. Send your order number and a photo. We’ll send a new one or refund you, at no cost to you. You don’t need to send it back.

If your order hasn’t arrived [CONFIRM: number] business days after it shipped, email us your order number and we’ll look into it. If it’s lost, we’ll send a new one or refund you.

Questions

Email [CONFIRM: support email] or use the Contact page. If it’s about an order, include your order number.

pages.title: Size & fit
pages.body:
[CONFIRM: every style we sell is one size with an adjustable back; if a fitted style is ever added, give it its own size chart here] So picking a hat is mostly about the style you like, plus a minute with a tape measure.

How to measure your head

  1. Use a soft tape measure. No tape? Use a piece of string, then hold it against a ruler.
  2. Wrap it around your head where a hat sits: just above your eyebrows and the tops of your ears, and around the back.
  3. Keep it snug, not tight. Read the number where the ends meet.
  4. Check it against the range for your style below.

Sizes and closures

Style Fits heads Closure
Dad hat [CONFIRM: dad hat head-size range, cm and inches] [CONFIRM: dad hat closure]
Structured snapback [CONFIRM: snapback head-size range, cm and inches] Snap
Trucker [CONFIRM: trucker head-size range, cm and inches] [CONFIRM: trucker closure]
Golf cap [CONFIRM: rope or performance cap, only if it launches; head-size range, cm and inches] [CONFIRM: golf cap closure]

How each style sits

  • Dad hat: soft and unstructured, with a curved brim. [CONFIRM: dad hat profile]
  • Structured snapback: a firm front that holds its shape. [CONFIRM: snapback profile; flat or curved brim]
  • Trucker: mesh at the back. [CONFIRM: trucker profile, front panel and brim]
  • Golf cap: [CONFIRM: only if it launches: golf cap profile, fabric and brim]

Adjusting the fit

  • Snap: line up the pegs with the holes at the setting that feels snug, then press them together.
  • [CONFIRM: how the dad hat and trucker closures adjust]

Still not sure?

Email your measurement to [CONFIRM: support email] and we’ll tell you which style should fit best.
